perimeter: the REDUCE-mean sufficient-statistics lowering rule on Acero.
rule_statement: a MULE mean is lowered as its sufficient statistics — AggregateRel[sum] and AggregateRel[count] — then a ProjectRel divide; the mean-of-means theorem as a lowering constraint. Conserves the mean denotation. Covers mean (and, by the same decomposition, weighted_mean/variance/stddev); NOT holistic mules (median/mode) or sketch distincts.
